entries.en: We've got geth in the tower.
The tower's secure. Thanks to you, Commander.
It's the company most of us worked for before the attacks. They fund this colony.
If you want answers, go ask them yourselves.
Commander? What can I do for you?
The geth fighters are too dangerous. And I won't be driven off this world. It is... our home.
Help me find what the geth are after and you'll all get out of here alive.
Tell me about your colony.
What can you tell me about the defenses the geth have set up?
I'll talk to you when I learn more.
How do I get there?
What's ExoGeni?
Tell me what the geth want. Why are they attacking you?
What do they want?
The Normandy isn't huge, but we could airlift you out.
Life is hard and often brutal, even without our current problems.
But, despite everything, there's something tranquil about this place. Unlike anything I've experienced before.
We were nearly a thousand at the main site. Two hundred more at my outpost.
There is a chance for growth here that is simply not available on other worlds.
I don't have any details, but I'll wager it's a lot more fortified than the command post.
Macha Doyle has been assigned to that particular issue. If you have any insight to offer, please speak with her.
Davin Reynolds is tasked with securing food for the immediate future. If you can assist, please speak with him.
Good luck, Commander.
I tried to fight it, but it gets in your head. You can't imagine the pain.
I was supposed to be a leader. These people trusted me.
How big was the original Feros colony?
Is there anything I can do to solve your water shortage?
You mentioned something about a food shortage.
Don't worry.
I need details.
Why?
Where is it located?
ExoGeni?
The colony
Geth base
Water shortage
Food shortage
Goodbye.
How many people lived here?
I could evacuate you.
Watch out!
They must be from the main colony. You should convince them to make their way here.
Everyone will be safer if we are together.
Yes, you said as much. I hope they will join us in our efforts to rebuild.
When the first wave obliterated our defenses, we fell back to Zhu's Hope.
They landed at least one geth ship at ExoGeni and I've seen large walking tanks on the skyway. Expect a hard fight.
I found another group of colonists who survived the initial attack.
There are other survivors.
You're a bit late, aren't you?
Arcelia!
Their main base is at the ExoGeni headquarters. A good place to start looking if you want answers.
It wants me to stop you... but I... I won't.
I won't!
Then maybe I can get this colony operational again.
What else can you tell me about ExoGeni?
We'll get going then.
ExoGeni
Sounds good.
I appreciate your concern... and your efforts against the geth.
If it's geth you're looking for, you've come to the right place.
Well, I'm glad you're on our side, then.
They may have been slowed, but they'll be back. They always come back.
We don't know what they're after. They came, they attacked us. That's all we know.
I'm just glad your colony is safe.
I'm interested in what Saren sent the geth to find. Nothing more.
I just did what I had to.
Happy to help.
I didn't do it for you.
It's my job.
Colonial Affairs back on Earth told us we'd be beneath the notice of any raiders. I guess they weren't counting on the geth.
ExoGeni funded this colony. Without them, we wouldn't be stuck here.
They specialize in colonization. In return for bankrolling the colony, we work for them.
Their main goal is the retrieval of valuable artifacts or resources.
Except there isn't anything here. Or if there is, we didn't find it.
Perhaps. As she said, we never found anything of value.
Of course, the geth could know something we don't.
I wonder if that's what the geth are looking for?
Artifacts?
The skyway leads directly to ExoGeni headquarters. You can't miss it.
We need those geth destroyed.
Arcelia is right. There are still geth in the tunnels. We also have more mundane problems, like food, water, and power.
Oh, Commander. I'm glad they finally sent somebody to help us.
Sorry, Commander. Everyone's on edge since--
We're a close-knit group, Commander. Most of us have lost loved ones, friends....
These aren't trained soldiers. Nobody taught us how to deal with the horrors of war!
This is our home. We've watched the geth slowly destroy everything that is important to us. Don't judge us too harshly.
Some of the colonists are acting strange.
What do you need done to get this place back on its feet?
Strange behavior.
Operational
We've been over this, Commander. The colonists are my concern. The geth are yours.
Protect the heart of the colony!
That would be Ian. He's very sick.
He hasn't been the same since the attack.
We tried to help him, but he wouldn't listen to us.
I can't help my people if they won't listen, Commander.
I wish it was that simple. Ian was a good man I'd like to have with us.
Please, Commander. I'd prefer not to talk about it any more.
There's a guy living down in the tunnels. Is he one of yours?
He seems to be more than just sick.
Don't you have medical supplies? Something to help him?
Man in tunnels.
No kidding.
Medicate him.
How many people lived here?
Of course, there's an army of geth between here and there.
I didn't expect this would be easy.
Every geth I kill brings me one step closer to Saren.
We're prepared.
No problem.
Good.
Getting rid of the geth in the tunnels helped us immensely, Commander.
But there are still other mundane necessities, like food, water, and power to think of.
I'm not sure where we stand on those matters. You should talk to the people overseeing them.
May O'Connell is working on our power problems. She'd know more about it than I do.
Nothing new. They're in the tunnels somewhere, likely guarding a transmitter to coordinate attacks.
We're sure that there are geth in the tunnels. We believe they were coordinating the geth attacks with a transmitter.
The tunnels make it impossible to track the signal, and even if we could, it's likely guarded heavily.
It's not a critical threat right now, but getting rid of that transmitter will help us defend against further attacks.
Thank you, Commander. We're in your debt.
You've taken a great weight off my shoulders. I just wish I had such good news for every problem.
Of course, Commander.
What's wrong with the colony's power supply?
Do you have information about geth in the lower tunnels?
I destroyed a geth transmitter in the tunnels. They won't be a problem any longer.
Let's talk about Zhu's Hope and Feros in general.
Power
Geth in tunnels
Stopped the geth
Another topic
